description: This file defines a plugin function 'addSeeds' for processing challenge files, including handling region markers and seed content sections, used in a challenge parsing pipeline.

methods.name: findRegionMarkers
methods.description: Identifies the line numbers of region markers in challenge file contents.

methods.name: removeLines
methods.description: Removes specified lines from content based on line indices.

methods.name: addSeeds
methods.description: Main plugin function that processes challenge tree to extract seed sections, handle region markers, and attach seed data to the file object.

methods.name: validateEditableMarkers
methods.description: Validates that lines with editable region markers are correctly formatted and only have one marker per line.
